name: Australian Vocational Training Academy
description:
Australian Vocational Training Academy (AVTA) is situated in Melbourne and the academy is passionate about providing high quality, practical education. Founded in 2000, it is a modern educational institution that provides good value training and assessment to prepare students for their future career pathways.

Inclusivity is a huge part of the academyâ€™s operation, with staff speaking over 14 languages combined and students travelling from all over the world.

The Australian Vocational Training Academy takes great pride in providing exceptional facilities for international students. The academy contains state-of-the-art classrooms and specialised training spaces that come complete with modern technology and resources. Students also have access to well-stocked libraries with a vast collection of academic materials, research databases, and digital resources to support their studies. Recreational facilities such as sports fields, fitness centres, and common areas are more communal areas available for student use. Support services such as counselling and career appointments are available to ensure that international students receive the necessary support.

Student Life

Campus life for international students at the Australian Vocational Training Academy is vibrant and diverse. Regular cultural events and workshops take place thanks to the academy and its mission to celebrate all different cultures and perspectives. Students can join clubs, societies, and student organisations that align with their interests and passions. The academy encourages students to pursue industry placements and volunteering initiatives to broaden their horizons.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
At the Australian Vocational Training Academy, accommodation for international students is a top priority so students have a convenient and comfortable place to stay during their studies. The academy offers a range of housing options that cater to the diverse needs and preferences of students. The features included in on-campus accommodation include modern amenities, such as spacious study areas, recreational facilities, and 24/7 security, fostering a safe and inclusive atmosphere.

Off-campus apartments are conveniently situated in close proximity to the academy, offering students the opportunity to experience independent living while still benefiting from the academy's support services.
